items.exampleEn: The concert was a tremendous success.
We want to minimize the cost of the trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們想把旅行費用降到最低。

items.exampleEn: We got only a partial refund for the cancelled flight.
items.exampleZh: 被取消的班機，我們只拿到部分退款。

items.exampleEn: My calculation shows that we need ten more chairs.
items.exampleZh: 我算出來我們還需要十張椅子。

items.exampleEn: Turn the meat often so it cooks evenly.
items.exampleZh: 肉要常翻面，才會熟得均勻。

items.exampleEn: I'll pay half now and the remainder next week.
items.exampleZh: 我現在先付一半，剩下的下週再付。

items.exampleEn: The car can go thirty miles on one gallon of gas.
items.exampleZh: 這台車一加侖油可以跑三十英里。

items.exampleEn: Please reduce your speed near the school.

items.sentenceEn: We need to reduce the amount of paper we use.

items.audioEn: The cake was divided evenly, so each child got the same size.
items.audioZh: 蛋糕切得很平均，所以每個小孩拿到的大小都一樣。
items.questionZh: 每個小孩拿到的蛋糕怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: Always save your work to minimize the risk of losing it.
items.sentenceZh: 隨時存檔，把資料遺失的風險降到最低。

items.sentenceEn: The team spent the remainder of the day cleaning up.
items.sentenceZh: 那天剩下的時間，團隊都在打掃。

items.stemEn: Turning off the lights helps ____ the electricity bill.
The meeting was only a ____ success; some problems are still not solved.
items.stemZh: 這次會議只算部分成功，有些問題還沒解決。

items.passageEn: Our family wanted to reduce our water use. My father did a quick calculation: we were using about ninety gallons of water a day! That was a tremendous amount. So we made a plan to minimize waste. We take shorter showers, and we give the remainder of our drinking water to the plants. We also share the housework evenly. After one month, we saw a partial success: our water bill dropped by twenty percent.
items.passageZh: 我們家想減少用水量。爸爸很快算了一下：我們一天大約用九十加侖的水！那是非常大的量。所以我們訂了一個減少浪費的計畫。我們縮短洗澡時間，把剩下的飲用水拿去澆植物。我們也平均分擔家事。一個月後，我們看到部分的成效：水費降了百分之二十。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸算出全家一天大約用多少水？

items.promptZh: 我們今年必須降低成本。
referenceEn: We must reduce our costs this year.
This year, we have to reduce costs.
rubricZh: reduce 表示「降低、減少」，後面直接接受詞（例如 reduce costs）

items.promptZh: 油漆塗得均勻，牆壁才會好看。
referenceEn: Paint the wall evenly, and it will look nice.
If you paint the wall evenly, it will look good.
rubricZh: 用 evenly 表示「均勻地」（例如 paint the wall evenly）
「才會好看」可寫，例如 it will look nice、so that it looks good 等
